brief.title: Label every claim in a note
brief.plain_summary: Read a draft note, summary or commit message, sort every claim by how it is known, attach the evidence each label needs, tie each conclusion to the claims it rests on, list unmeasured values with reasons and state the limits.
brief.outcome: A labeled note that passes the claim checks, with unlabeled claims marked unverified.

draft.description: Pin of the draft note, summary or commit message.

evidence.description: Pins of run records the draft cites.

output_store.description: Store for the produced nouns. The default is a placeholder; use the store your owner assigned.

output_contract.delivery: Write produced nouns surface_only under your own authenticated surface, which is the requester's assigned surface, so the requester and that surface's reviewers can read them. Never use public_commons or allowlist other surfaces. Return every produced noun's pin in output.artifacts; add its value when the requester asks for inline delivery.

outcome_meanings.claims_labeled: The declared nouns were produced and every deterministic acceptance check passed.
outcome_meanings.no_change: The evidence does not justify producing or changing anything. Say why.
outcome_meanings.unknown: The question could not be answered with the permitted inputs. List what is missing and what would resolve it.
outcome_meanings.blocked: A required input, permission or capability is missing. Ask one precise question.

acceptance_checks.check: The note validates against template.note's schema.
The note passes every check in claim-checks.
Every label matches the evidence attached to it.

creates.nouns: The worker writes the nouns listed in output_contract.produces and returns their pins.
creates.verbs: The worker proposes follow-up verbs in output.proposed_verbs, such as a breakdown into smaller verbs or a research follow-up, with the pins they need. Proposals are never enqueued by the worker; an authorized requester enqueues the ones worth doing.

required: Verify the pins. Label each claim from its evidence, not from how confident it sounds.
A claim with no evidence is unverified; say what would confirm it.
Rest conclusions only on measured, read or verified claims; propose reproduce-claim for any reported number a conclusion needs.
List every value that was not measured, with the reason, instead of writing zero.
Return follow-up work the results justify as proposed_verbs and nouns worth creating later as proposed_nouns. Never enqueue them yourself; an authorized requester decides which to run.

brief.title: Append a correction
brief.plain_summary: When a claim did not reproduce or is found wrong, append a correction with what was claimed, what was true, how the error was made and who found it, and propose a revised note that keeps the original claim on the record.
brief.outcome: A correction, or no_change when the evidence does not contradict the claim.

brief.outcome: A note audit that passes or lists the changes needed.
